sourcedDescription: PowerX OneWallet is running a community airdrop that pays 500 PX1 to every participant who completes the social tasks in the PowerX Airdrop Bot and verifies in the app. No purchase or deposit is needed. The product already exists, and finishing the tasks is also what unlocks the app download link.
tagline_en: PowerX OneWallet is running a community airdrop that pays 500 PX1 to every participant who completes the social tasks in the PowerX Airdrop Bot and verifies in the app. No purchase or deposit is needed. The product already exists, and finishing the tasks is also what unlocks the app download link.

sourcedSteps.title: Open the PowerX Airdrop Bot
sourcedSteps.body: Open the PowerX Airdrop Bot on Telegram and tap Start. The bot lists your tasks and tracks which ones you’ve finished.

sourcedSteps.title: Join the PowerX Telegram Community
sourcedSteps.body: Join the PowerX Telegram group from the bot’s task list.

sourcedSteps.title: Follow the Announcement Channel
sourcedSteps.body: Follow the PowerX announcement channel on Telegram, where the team posts project updates.

sourcedSteps.title: Follow PowerX on X
sourcedSteps.body: Follow PowerX One on X and engage with the pinned post as the bot instructs.

sourcedSteps.title: Download PowerX OneWallet
sourcedSteps.body: Once the tasks above are done, the bot unlocks the download link. Android users install the app from Google Play. iPhone users join the beta through Apple TestFlight, so install the TestFlight app first.

sourcedSteps.title: Create or Import a Wallet
sourcedSteps.body: Open the app and create a new wallet, or import one you already use. If you create a new one, write the recovery phrase down offline. It’s generated on your phone and PowerX has no way to restore it.

sourcedSteps.title: Verify and Claim Your PX1
sourcedSteps.body: Complete the verification in the app to secure your 500 PX1. The tokens go to the wallet you verified with at TGE, so keep access to it.

sourcedSteps.title: Invite Friends for Extra PX1
sourcedSteps.body: Share your referral link from the PowerX Airdrop Bot to earn additional PX1 on top of the 500 PX1 base reward. This step is optional.
